canon.note: Hellscape (1120502) L10: consumes 30% Max HP, enhances Basic to Forest of Swords for #2 = 3 turns, grants an Extra Turn, no Energy. Forest of Swords (1120508) L6 (engine default Basic Lv6): #2 = 130% main, #3 = 52% adjacent, HP cost #1 = 10%, generates no SP; canon main split 2 hits 50/50. Death Sentence (1120503) L10: #1 = 150% Max HP main, #3 = 60% adjacent (Blast), sets HP to 50%. Shuhu's Gift (1120504) L10: FUA #2 = 130% Max HP (A6 Cyclone of Destruction +20% FUA DMG -> 156%), split 33/33/34, heals #3 = 25% Max HP, +15 Energy from A6.

fixtures.env: Blade E0 solo vs 3 Wind-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Death Sentence (1120503) is Blade's Ultimate action (2 casts in the fixture).
Hellscape (1120502) is Blade's Skill action (2 casts: the first expires after its 3 turns, the second re-applies it).
Blade performs 3 Basic ATK actions (the 2 extra-turn basics from Hellscape are not separate logged actions).
Forest of Swords (1120508) main-target damage lands 10 times in the fixture (5 casts x 2 hits, canon 50% + 50%).
Forest of Swords hits both adjacent enemies on every cast (5 casts x 2 adjacent = 10).
Shuhu's Gift (1120504) Follow-Up ATK fires on all 3 enemies with the canon 3-hit split (3 casts x 3 enemies x 3 slices = 27 events in the fixture).
Death Sentence (1120503) Blast main-target hit occurs once per Ultimate (2 casts).
Death Sentence hits both adjacent enemies per Ultimate (2 x 2 = 4).
Forest of Swords cannot regenerate Skill Points (1120508: "cannot regenerate Skill Points") — Blade gains no SP in the fixture.
Hellscape has bp_need = 1 and is cast twice, costing 2 Skill Points total.
Forest of Swords L6 (1120508 #2) main total 130% of Max HP over the 50%+50% split; last (50%) piece = 0.65.
Forest of Swords L6 (1120508 #3) adjacent multiplier totals 52% of Max HP.
Shuhu's Gift L10 (1120504 #2 = 130%) plus A6 Cyclone of Destruction (+20% FUA DMG) = 156% of Max HP, split 33/33/34; last piece carries 34% -> 0.5304.
Death Sentence L10 (1120503 #1) main multiplier is 150% of Max HP.
Death Sentence L10 (1120503 #3) adjacent multiplier is 60% of Max HP.
Over the fixture Blade regenerates exactly 200 Energy (Skill grants none per 1120502; FUA grants +25 per A6 Cyclone of Destruction).
Hellscape lasts #2 = 3 turns at L10 (1120502).
Trace A2 (in-heal +20%, permanent) is active as an unlimited-duration buff throughout the battle.
Shuhu's Gift restores Blade's HP by 25% of Max HP (1120504 #3) after each Follow-Up ATK; 3 heal events fire (one per FUA, 3 FUAs in the fixture).
Forest of Swords damage resolves before the first Death Sentence damage in the fixture (Blade builds energy before his first Ultimate).
